subject: Energy
title: The Inflation Reduction Act
description: One-minute skill: The Inflation Reduction Act.

hook.text: The US Inflation Reduction Act (2022) committed $369 billion to clean energy—the largest climate spend in US history.

buildup.text: Tax credits for solar, wind, EVs, heat pumps, and batteries make clean technology cheaper for consumers and businesses.

discovery.text: Manufacturing incentives aim to build a domestic clean energy supply chain—reducing dependence on Chinese imports.

twist.text: The IRA works through carrots, not sticks—subsidies rather than mandates, making it harder to repeal politically.

climax.text: Analysts estimate the IRA could cut US emissions by 40% below 2005 levels by 2030—a major acceleration.

punchline.text: $369 billion in clean energy incentives—policy at scale.

quiz.question: How does the IRA primarily encourage clean energy adoption?
